algorithm.input: complete raw BrandTheme snapshot; raw values remain editor/audit data
algorithm.colorSpace: 8-bit sRGB; no HSL, OKLCH, browser color parser or ICC conversion
algorithm.normalization: accept exactly #RRGGBB case-insensitively and emit uppercase #RRGGBB
algorithm.channelRounding: round-half-up per channel: floor(((first * firstPercent) + (second * (100 - firstPercent))) / 100 + 0.5)

contrast.focus: two-layer ring: 2px surface offset separates the primary control, 3px solid outer ring must be >=3:1 against canvas and surface

foregroundChoice.preservePreferredWhen: minimum contrast against every supplied background is >=4.5:1
foregroundChoice.exhaustedFallback: candidate with highest minimum contrast; ties retain correctionOrder

gamutCorrection.candidates: base; 1..100% mixes toward black; 1..100% mixes toward white; then #000000..#FFFFFF neutral grays
gamutCorrection.choice: closest squared Euclidean 8-bit sRGB distance that meets every threshold; ties by uppercase hex; if none meets, highest minimum contrast then distance then hex

interactiveFillCorrection.rule: primary/accent/sidebar fills search the same finite candidate gamut until every generated state has a >=3:1 environment boundary and its declared foreground has >=4.5:1

foregroundModes.sidebarGradient: one shared foreground across all stops
foregroundModes.sidebarActive: per-state foreground on soft active backgrounds

interactiveFillCorrection.sidebarMuted: start at 68% sidebarText over sidebarMid, then increase sidebarText one integer percentage point through 100 until 4.5:1 is met across every gradient stop

algorithm.fixedFunctionalColorRule: success, warning, danger, info, locked and planboard palettes are not derived from tenant colors and remain authoritative in fieldflow-tokens.json

nativeRuntimeChrome.background: semantic canvas; safe-area background is identical
nativeRuntimeChrome.style: Style.Dark when black icon contrast is greater than or exactly equal to white icon contrast; Style.Light otherwise
nativeRuntimeChrome.scope: Capacitor runtime status bar and web safe-area only; native launcher name/package/icon, OS splash and build-time notification/channel assets are excluded

failClosedResolution.candidateSafety: safe only when raw input has no invalid field diagnostics, no correction reports thresholdMet=false and every declared semantic contrast pair passes
failClosedResolution.activationFailure: status rejected; do not persist/activate; return the complete last-safe effective snapshot supplied by the editor
failClosedResolution.runtimeFailure: status fallback; atomically return the complete hash-verified safe platform fallback; never merge candidate and fallback tokens
failClosedResolution.integrityFailure: stale or hash-mismatched snapshots bypass candidate activation and use the same atomic fallback path

hashes.rawBrandTheme: SHA-256 of compact JSON serialized in BRAND_THEME_FIELD_ORDER; this preserves the existing canonical fixture hash
hashes.semanticOutputAndDiagnostics: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted compact JSON with no trailing newline

runtimePolicy.rawPreservation: Never overwrite persisted/editor raw values with corrected display values.
runtimePolicy.functionalPalettes: Use fieldflow-tokens.json.colors.semantic and .planboard unchanged by tenant brand colors.
runtimePolicy.serverRendering: Resolve one complete appearance server-side; serialize the same context-bound appearance snapshot for SSR, portals and hydration.

appearanceResolutionContract.trustedContextSource: canonical host resolver + server authentication tenant + monotone tenant_theme_settings.theme_revision + server entitlement resolver + persisted override/presentation flags
appearanceResolutionContract.clientAuthority: none; Host forwarding is accepted only through the trusted-proxy policy and query/body/client storage never selects a tenant or revision

hashes.contextSha256: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted compact JSON containing exactly contextFieldOrder
hashes.appearanceSha256: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted compact JSON containing context, contextSha256, effective raw hash, assetModesSha256, identity, communication and semanticOutput
hashes.resultSha256: SHA-256 of the complete appearance result excluding resultSha256

appearanceResolutionContract.atomicity: Every consumer receives identity, explicit asset modes, communication, CSS semantics and native chrome from the same verified appearanceSha256; candidate raw fields are never consumed beside it.
appearanceResolutionContract.mismatch: Any invalid snapshot context, context-hash mismatch or raw-hash mismatch follows the same complete safe-platform fallback path; an invalid trusted server context is a hard error and emits nothing.

storageMigration.revisionRule: increment exactly once in the same transaction as every effective theme, mode or asset-reference change

resolution.inherit: use the hash-verified effective platform asset for the same host
resolution.asset: require a server-owned storage path for the correct platform/tenant/kind and derive the delivery URL server-side
resolution.none: force effective URL and storagePath to null without falling through to platform

assetSelectionContract.legacyBackfill: valid tenant-owned path becomes asset; no tenant asset becomes inherit; external URL becomes asset only after allowlist/ownership migration, otherwise inherit plus an audit warning
assetSelectionContract.forbidden: Never infer a mode from a nullable URL/path at runtime and never prefer a client URL over the server-owned path.

manifest.name: resolved brandName plus the fixed product suffix Klantportaal or Personeelsapp
manifest.shortName: grapheme-safe server truncation of brandName to at most 24 characters
manifest.description: host-resolved tenant-facing copy with no hardcoded provider name in white-label mode

scope.rule: The canonical verified host may prepend an origin but may not change the product path boundary.

generatedAssets.maskableSafeZone: all essential logo pixels remain inside the centered 80% circle/box
generatedAssets.splash: 1080x1920 portrait plus CSS canvas fallback; contain without crop
generatedAssets.source: effective favicon asset; when absent or invalid use deterministic brandName initials on semantic primary
generatedAssets.contentType: image/png or image/webp; never SVG for generated install assets

pwaInstallContract.versioning: Every dynamic manifest, icon and splash URL carries themeRevision and appearanceSha256; responses use immutable ETag/content hashes and caches partition by canonical host+tenantId+themeRevision.
pwaInstallContract.staticAssetConflict: Legacy public manifest/favicon/install icons and service-worker precache entries must be removed or redirect with no-store to the host-resolved endpoints; two competing manifests or stale static icons are release blockers.
pwaInstallContract.serviceWorker: Install/update purges appearance assets from another host, tenant or revision and never serves tenant A branding while tenant B resolves.
pwaInstallContract.responsiveEvidence: Customer and personnel portal matrices must capture install prompt/standalone launch, 320/390/768/1440 widths, long brandName, wide/tall/broken logo, all three asset modes and offline reload.

schema.invoices: reuse immutable company_snapshot_json plus invoice template/payment snapshots and add appearanceSha256 to the finalized aggregate

documentAppearanceSnapshotContract.readRule: Final PDF and every backoffice/customer compatibility route render brand name, attribution, logo, palette and footer only from the stored document snapshot; no current tenant-theme lookup may change an issued document. The logo fetch uses the exact owned storage path plus immutable object version and verifies contentSha256, MIME and byte length before decode.
documentAppearanceSnapshotContract.assetRetention: A logo object referenced by an issued snapshot is versioned/retained and cannot be overwritten or deleted until the legal retention window expires; render failure is explicit and never falls through to a current tenant logo or external URL.
documentAppearanceSnapshotContract.legacyBackfill: The migration snapshots each legacy issued document once from its existing legal/company/template data plus the then-effective verified appearance, records a migration audit event and never lazily mutates on GET.

internalThemeResultType.resultSha256: sha256 over the complete result payload excluding resultSha256

resolutionContract.editorActivation: Call resolveAppearance with mode=activation, a server-trusted context, expected raw and asset-mode hashes, and the current last-safe effective raw snapshot plus its verified hash and asset modes as safeFallback. On rejected, do not save/publish candidate raw; keep the returned complete last-safe appearance active.
resolutionContract.runtime: Call resolveAppearance with mode=runtime and safePlatformFallback. On invalid, unresolvable, stale or hash-mismatched input, publish only the returned complete fallback appearance as one snapshot.
resolutionContract.atomicity: Never merge candidate identity, assets, communication, token fields, diagnostics or native chrome into fallback output. Every surface swaps from one complete appearanceSha256 to another.
resolutionContract.rawAudit: Rejected/fallback candidate raw stays available only through its existing audit record and requestedRawBrandThemeSha256; corrected or fallback values never overwrite it.

nativeRuntimeContract.styleRule: Compare WCAG contrast of black and white system-icon proxies against nativeStatusBarBackground; black >= white, including an exact tie, emits Style.Dark; otherwise emit Style.Light.
nativeRuntimeContract.coldStart: Before a verified same-host/tenant cached snapshot or SSR snapshot is available, derive and use the native tuple from safePlatformFallback.rawBrandTheme. Apply background, icon style and safe-area color as one transition after resolution.
nativeRuntimeContract.cacheIsolation: A last-known theme may be reused only under host + tenantId + themeRevision; never show tenant A chrome while tenant B resolves.

canonicalFixturePolicy.reason: The approved CI reference is an authored, accessibility-normalized pixel fixture. Existing canonical token values win only for that visual fixture when they satisfy the declared state pair; this is not a production theme fallback and is never applied to a tenant runtime theme.
canonicalFixturePolicy.stateExtensionRule: Semantic states absent from the authored canonical palette are deterministically derived. Pinned prototype CSS for active navigation is copied exactly into its soft background, text and separate indicator tokens.

canonicalBridgeMapping.nonCollapseRule: Do not alias foreground to text, mutedSurface to secondarySoft, or line to borderSubtle; the authored canonical fixture intentionally has distinct values.

focus.rule: Never replace this with color alone or suppress it on :focus-visible.

diagnosticContract.order: normalization in BrandTheme color/enum order, then semantic derivation order

codes.INVALID_HEX_FALLBACK: Raw value is not exactly #RRGGBB; algorithm fallback is used for display output.
codes.INVALID_ENUM_FALLBACK: Font/radius/density value is outside the closed set; algorithm fallback is used.
codes.FOREGROUND_ADJUSTED: Preferred foreground failed 4.5:1 in at least one state/background.
codes.TEXT_CONTRAST_ADJUSTED: A normal text color was moved to the nearest passing sRGB candidate.
codes.BOUNDARY_ADJUSTED: A meaningful boundary or filled control was moved to the nearest 3:1 candidate.
codes.FOCUS_RING_ADJUSTED: The outer focus ring was moved to remain 3:1 against canvas and surface.
codes.INTERACTIVE_FILL_ADJUSTED: Primary/accent was moved so every state has a 3:1 environment boundary and its state foreground has 4.5:1.
codes.SIDEBAR_BACKGROUND_ADJUSTED: Sidebar base was moved so all gradient stops and shared text remain accessible.
codes.SIDEBAR_ACTIVE_ADJUSTED: Active navigation soft backgrounds or strong indicators were moved to remain distinguishable from every gradient stop.

diagnosticContract.persistenceRule: Diagnostics are derived response metadata; never persist corrected values over tenant input.

requiredAssertions: all nine raw hashes, resolve-result hashes, safe platform fallback hash and immutable canonical raw hash match
expected semantic and combined resolution hashes match
every declared normal-text pair is at least 4.5:1
every declared meaningful boundary pair is at least 3:1
no effective-output diagnostic has thresholdMet=false; candidate failures are allowed only with fallback/rejected status
unresolvable, invalid, stale and hash-mismatched candidates never expose partial candidate tokens
canonical foreground/text, mutedSurface/secondarySoft and line/borderSubtle remain distinct
authored active navigation equals archived prototype CSS and has no normalization override
FFC-BRAND-019 light, dark, adversarial and exact-tie outputs match

fixtures.purpose: Immutable authored Fieldflow Calm visual-CI fixture; exact raw object and hash from fieldflow-tokens.json.

rawBrandTheme.emailFooterText: Dit is een automatisch bericht van Fieldgrid.

fixtures.purpose: Very light brand and sidebar colors force dark foreground and boundary correction.

expectedDiagnostics.context: sidebar gradient against canvas/surface with shared text

fixtures.purpose: Dark canvas, surface and sidebar verify light text, borders and state colors.

expectedDiagnostics.context: sidebar gradient against canvas/surface with shared text

fixtures.purpose: Saturated red brand verifies that brand states remain separate from fixed danger semantics.
Bright yellow exercises the classic white-on-brand contrast failure and dark foreground selection.
Neutral-only tenant branding verifies that fixed statuses and selection do not depend on hue.
Deliberately malformed full-shape input keeps correction diagnostics available for preview but proves runtime rejects invalid raw and atomically uses the safe platform fallback.
Valid raw adversarial split: black canvas, white surface and #808080 text/muted cannot produce one AA foreground across canvas, surface and mixed surface-subtle; runtime must fail closed.
Valid inverse adversarial split: white canvas, black surface and #808080 text/muted cannot produce one AA foreground across canvas, surface and mixed surface-subtle; runtime must fail closed.
